conditions.zero: physical-space zeros_like(correct), then frozen WM normalization

within_task_shuffle.rule: fixed-seed whole-chunk derangement within each task; source sample identity differs

cross_task_shuffle.rule: fixed-seed whole-chunk sample from a different task; original language is retained

conditions.magnitude_rule: multiply correct actions in raw physical space; do not clip; then apply frozen WM normalization

optional_gradient_analysis.reason: a faithful full [8,512] by [8,7] Jacobian over representative samples is disproportionately expensive; scalar-gradient surrogates would not answer the requested Jacobian-norm question

priority: world-model local action sensitivity before reranker; candidate redesign remains diagnostic-only

expert_action_caveat: expert action is an imitation-oriented diagnostic target; nearest expert action does not imply optimal closed-loop task success
